title: Headcount sync + hiring loop 1:1 prep (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting: Headsync + interview loop 1:1 prep (hiring manager)
Owner: Priya Patel (notes + follow-ups)
Purpose: prep for 1:1 with Eng DM to align on open reqs, candidate debriefs, interview feedback, and next steps for headcount plan. Quick scratchpad — rough, will clean up for follow-up.

Agenda draft (30m)
- Quick status (5m): open reqs, req priorities, top blockers on offers/hiring velocity
- Interview loop debrief (10m): candidates this week, clear/unclear signals, calibration issues
- Headcount / capacity planning (10m): budget vs hiring pace, backfill prioritization, potential freezes or swaps
- Actions & owners (5m): confirm interviewers, offer owners, comm plan to execs

Current open reqs (summary)
- ENG-req-137 (infra infra reliability SWE) – hiring manager: Alex R.
  - Stage: final onsites done (2/26). Waiting for slate synthesis / hiring committee.
  - Comp band: L4-L5, target start: May.
- ENG-req-142 (platform-engineering) – HM: Maria C.
  - Stage: loop scheduled 3/9, 2 strong interviewers confirmed.
- ENG-req-149 (applied-ml infra) – HM: Jordan L.
  - Stage: screen failed 2 candidates, re-opened; net-new req from Q1 reprioritization.

Hiring velocity notes (quick numbers)
- Offers extended YTD: 12 (8 accepted, 2 declined, 2 pending)
- Avg time from open->offer: 52 days (goal <45)
- Need to accelerate for Dedicated infra hires — 2-3 swappable reqs possible if exec okay

Interview loop debriefs (candidates this week)
- Candidate: SDE-c-2026-01 (senior runtime)
  - Interviewers: Jordan L, Priya P, Samir G
  - Feedback summary: strong system design, borderline on low-level perf optimizations. Cultural fit: +
  - Red flags: limited exposure to our stack (CUDA/TVM) but high learning velocity
  - Recommendation: move to final onsite; consider pairing task to mitigate perf risk

- Candidate: ML-platform-17
  - Interviewers: Maria C, Alex R
  - Feedback summary: good infra/ML infra knowledge, unclear ops experience
  - Recommendation: need clarification interview focused on on-call/troubleshooting scenarios

Debrief notes & calibration issues
- Interview feedback forms are very terse; ask interviewers to add concrete examples (what candidate did/said) — will follow up 1:1 with each interviewer who wrote < 3 bullet points.
- Calibration: Samir's scoring trend is conservative; to discuss alignment with Jordan during hiring committee.
- Need to ensure rubric updated for quantized inference familiarity vs general MLOps — link to rubric PR in linked_artifacts.

Offer pipeline blockers
- Compensation approval delay: finance flagged one counteroffer as above band; need headcount committee sign-off before Monday (3/8).
- Candidate notice period: two targets have 6-8 weeks — need backup shortlist to hit Q2 ramp.

Questions to ask DM in 1:1
- On ENG-req-137: is start date flexible? Can we offer contractor bridging?
- Which reqs can be deprioritized if budget tightened (top 2 swappable)?
- Are there internal candidates we should prioritize for backfills?
- Any feedback on interviewer calibration / new hires in the team?

Action items (capture during/after meeting)
- [Priya] Send 1-pager to DM summarizing candidates + recommended next steps for each (due: 2026-03-04).
- [Alex R] Prepare comp justification for ENG-req-137 counteroffer (due: 2026-03-06).
- [Jordan L] Run calibration sync with Samir to align scoring (due: 2026-03-05).
- [Maria C] Schedule clarification interview for ML-platform-17 (due: 2026-03-09).
- [Priya] Draft hiring committee note and attach candidate packets (due: 2026-03-07).

Notes to self / talking points
- Emphasize speed trade-offs: candidate with curve on TVM can ramp vs longer search for perfect perf hire.
- Budget lens: remind DM of committed reserved capacity for Dedicated this fiscal — stretch to justify earlier hires where product impact obvious.
- Suggest trial offer structure: 6-month review with performance milestones for candidates with skill gaps (tie comp to ramp).

Follow-ups post-meeting (template)
- Quick summary email to DM + people-ops list (Priya to send): decisions, owners, next deadlines, next check-in (weekly headsync).
- Update candidate status board (JIRA/Hire) and notify recruiters of greenlights/blocks.

Unresolved items / things to investigate
- Need final benchmarking numbers for perf impact of hire vs contractor cost — ask infra leads for estimate (Samir to get).
- Backfill sequencing impact on product roadmap (ask PM leads during next sync).

Scratchpad: possible compromises if budget constrained
- Move two L5 hires to L4+senior IC + strong onboarding plan (saves ~20% comp).
- Use contractor for kernel-level perf work for 3 months to buy hiring runway.

Slack snippets (for quick copy-paste)
- To hiring-team: "Headsync: Please review candidate packets for ENG-req-137 by EOD Thu (3/5). Priya will post short summary + recommendation"
- To finance: "Quick note — comp request for ENG-req-137 pending approval; need decision by 3/6 to keep our offer timeline."

Random notes (brain dump)
- Consider adding an explicit on-call question to ML-platform loop.
- Check if SRE has capacity to pair up for kernel perf interview next week.
- Remind recruiting to keep candidate experience tight (fast scheduling window).

---
End scratchpad. Will tidy and export to confluence + send follow-ups after 1:1.
